title: Default Service Restart Fallback
specification:
# PRD: Default Service Restart Fallback

Priority: High

## Problem
The Restart services button currently queues a restart job, but for autonomy-v2 it skips execution when serverRestartCommand and controlBridgeRestartCommand are not configured.

## Goal
Support a safe default restart path that can stop and relaunch the current control panel server and control bridge when explicit restart commands are absent.

## Requirements
- Record service lifecycle metadata for the control panel server and control bridge, including PID, cwd, launch command or restart command, and timestamp.
- When explicit restart commands are configured, preserve the current configured-command behavior.
- When restart commands are missing, create a default restart plan from the recorded lifecycle metadata.
- Execute default restart through a detached helper so the bridge can complete the restart job and heartbeat before stopping itself.
- Stop the server and bridge processes using only verified registered PIDs, then relaunch the server first and bridge last.
- Report clear statuses for restarted, skipped, missing metadata, stale PID, and relaunch failure cases.
- Add logs/events that make restart outcomes visible in the control panel job history.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Clicking Restart services on autonomy-v2 no longer reports skipped solely because restart commands are missing, provided valid lifecycle metadata exists.
- If lifecycle metadata is absent or stale, the job fails or skips with a clear reason instead of guessing processes.
- The restart job is marked complete or terminal before the current bridge process exits.
- After a default restart, both the server and control bridge come back online and emit fresh heartbeat/status data.
- Configured restart commands continue to work as they do today.

## Verification
- Unit-test restart plan selection for configured commands, valid default metadata, missing metadata, and stale PID cases.
- Integration-test the detached helper against a local server/bridge pair using temporary PID metadata.
- Manually verify the Restart services button on autonomy-v2 shows a successful restart and the control panel reconnects after the bridge relaunches.
- Verify logs/job history distinguish skipped, failed, and restarted outcomes.
